news.title: Global law enforcement agencies, tech firms disrupt West African scam network
news.summary: A group of law enforcement agencies from around the world teamed up with a handful of high-profile technology firms to disrupt West African criminal scam networks, the Justice Department (DOJ) announced Tuesday.
